My symptoms get worse when I lie down and better when I sit up.

opening.text: I get a burning feeling that starts in my stomach and goes up into my throat, sometimes with a bitter taste in my mouth. My symptoms get worse after I eat and when I lie down, but they're better when I sit up. I also have a cough. I have a hiatal hernia, and I drink too much alcohol or I'm addicted to it.
